fullContent:
Rohitaka Lauha 
 Reference – Ayurveda Sara Sangraha, 17 edition, page no.486. 
 Introduction 
 Rohitaka Lauha is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This formulation is known to control pitta and rakta doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Rohitaka for kwath 
 108 grams of following two:- 
 Rohitaka ( Tecomella undulata ) 
 Loha bhsama iron calx 
 12 grams of following ingredients:- 
 Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ) 
 Bahera ( Terminalia bellirica ) 
 Amla ( Emblica officinalis ) 
 Saunth ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) 
 Chitrakmool bark ( Plumbago zeylanica ) 
 Nagarmotha ( Cyperus rotundus ) 
 Vidanga ( Embelia ribes ) 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients from number 4 to 12 and number 2 also. 
 Powder all the ingredients very finely. 
 Add the loha bhsama in the above powder mixture. 
 After the mixing process, triturate with rohitaka’s kwath and dry in shade without sun rays. 
 
 Dosage 
 375mg two times a day, with buttermilk or milk. 
 Indications 
 
 Liver diseases 
 Jaundice 
 Splenomegaly 
 Fever 
 Cough 
 Hepatitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
